title: API Documentation Essentials
summary: Comprehensive API documentation including authentication, endpoints, and examples drives adoption and ease of use.

content.overview: Good documentation is crucial for developers integrating with an API.
content.details: Include: Authentication methods, endpoint descriptions, request/response examples, error codes meanings, rate limits and quotas. Use tools like OpenAPI/Swagger for specification, Postman collections for interactive docs.
content.examples: OpenAPI spec snippet describing GET /users with 200 response schema; Postman collection demonstrating request flow.
content.caveats: Keep documentation up-to-date with API changes; outdated docs cause integration issues and developer frustration.
